description: List every marketplace connected to this workspace with its setup state, health, last activity, any current sync error, orders revenue per currency, leads, product counts on the channel and how many imported products are waiting to be reviewed. Answers 'which channels do I sell on and is anything broken'. Takes no arguments. Use get_marketplace for one channel in detail, list_channel_products for what is on it, and check_channel_readiness for what it will refuse.
name: list_marketplaces
title: List marketplaces
